name: Elixirs for the Bladeleafs
summary: In Dolanaar, Syral Bladeleaf seeks help supplying her family's busy trade. Her husband spends nearly all his time brewing, and fresh elixirs could ease his burden while bringing him uncommon herbs.

sections.title: A Burden of Prosperity
sections.body: Dolanaar sees travelers, sentinels, and druids crossing Teldrassil. Syral Bladeleaf and her husband have built a thriving herb and alchemy trade to serve them. Demand keeps him at vials and cauldrons for nearly all his waking hours. The work leaves little time for the two of them.

sections.title: A Trader's Exchange
sections.body: Syral asks passing herbalists and brewers to ease her husband's workload. She seeks Elixirs of Lion's Strength and Minor Defense, and offers freshly gathered, uncommon herbs in exchange. For a budding alchemist beneath the Great Tree, the trade brings a bundle of herbs and a chance to turn common forest plants into prized local wares.

faq.q: Why does Syral Bladeleaf need these potions?
faq.answer: Syral Bladeleaf’s family shop in Dolanaar is busy, and her husband spends nearly all his time brewing to meet demand. Another brewer's work on the elixirs would give him a much-needed break.

faq.q: What potions are required for the task?
aliases: what do i need to brew
faq.answer: Syral asks for six Elixirs of Lion's Strength and two Elixirs of Minor Defense. Adventurers and local sentinels in Teldrassil often buy both kinds.

faq.q: What herbs are needed to brew the required elixirs?
faq.answer: The batch calls for Silverleaf, Earthroot, and standard Crystal Vials. Silverleaf and Earthroot grow across Teldrassil’s forest floor.
Syral’s request is for alchemists with basic skill in the craft. She needs dependable, well-mixed remedies for her shop.

faq.q: What does Syral offer in exchange for the elixirs?
faq.answer: Syral offers a bundle of freshly gathered, uncommon herbs in exchange for the elixirs. They are hard to find along Teldrassil’s woodland trails.

aliases: where do i turn this in
faq.answer: Syral Bladeleaf is outside Dolanaar’s northern building, near the central road through the forest village.

angles.text: Teldrassil’s rich soil yields Silverleaf and Earthroot, so you can gather the herbs for Syral’s shop order.
As a Night Elf, you know the Bladeleafs’ trade is part of life in Dolanaar beneath Teldrassil’s canopy.
As an Alliance member, you can help keep Dolanaar supplied with restorative and defensive draughts for defenders and traveling allies facing woodland threats.
